map.由流量系数、堰宽与堰上水头，按 Q=(2/3)Cd·b·√(2g)·H^1.5: From the discharge coefficient, weir width and head over the weir, the flow is Q=(2/3)Cd·b·√(2g)·H^1.5.
map.填写「堰上水头 H (m)」。: Enter the head over the weir H (m).
map.明渠流量用薄壁堰计量。: Open channel flow is measured with a thin-plate weir.
map.按堰宽与水头算泄流。: Compute the discharge from the weir width and the head.
map.行近流速修正与淹没判别。: Approach velocity correction and submerged flow discrimination.
map.：H 0.3→0.45，Q 增约 1.84 倍（H^1.5），量水堰对水头敏感需: H from 0.3 to 0.45 raises Q by about 1.84 times (H^1.5), so a measuring weir is sensitive to the head and needs careful measurement.
map.上游流速大时需加行近速度水头，否则 Q 偏低。: When the upstream velocity is high you must add the approach velocity head, otherwise Q comes out low.
map.下游水位淹过堰顶时泄量受顶托下降，需测下游水头修正。: When the downstream level submerges the weir crest the discharge drops from backwater effects, so measure the downstream head and correct.
map.→ 打开矩形薄壁堰工具: → Open the Rectangular Thin-Plate Weir tool
